desc: Derive the feasibility reduction: base sweep to n-1 and back to t, edge-pair demands, MWIS dual, and O(n) prefix/suffix plan.
Validate the produced code on the two provided samples and a small brute-force BFS/walk enumerator for n<=5, m<=12, random points 1..5.
Run a large performance sanity test (n=5*10^4, m=10^9) to confirm the O(n log V) check is fast enough.
Produce the final clean code block containing only the `Solution` class and `maxScore` method, removing the `__main__` harness and `import time`.
Re-run the two provided samples on the cleaned code and confirm the outputs are 4 and 2.
